name: ZUGFeRD / Factur-X (German e-invoice)
description: Adds the e-invoice data (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X) to the invoices you write in Yorik, so accounting software such as DATEV, Lexware or sevDesk can read them by itself. Required for business-to-business invoices in Germany from 2025 on.
author: yorik-core
